text: Chaukhandi Tombs Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Chaukhandi Tombs Type: Monument - Tomb Province: Sindh District: Karachi Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 17th-18th Century CE Description: These are pyramidal type tomb of Baloch warriors and their families, who had settled here in 17th and 18th centuries. The graves are decorated with stone slabs chiseled out in human, figural and other conventional designs. The most conspicuous features of the graves are the devices signifying the gentle and the sterner sex. Depicted on male internments is the horseman with ornaments like shield, sword, arrow and bow. Some graves are crowned with boss and turban. The female graves are symbolized with ornaments like the necklace, bracelet, anklet, ringlet, etc. Latitude: 24.863908333 Longitude: 67.271366667 Ownership: Federal Government Legal Status: Protected by The Antiquity Act 1975 (As amended in 1992) Title of Publication: Inventory of Cultural Property in the Province of Sindh, Pakistan, 2015 Published In: Government of Sindh, Vol 2 Year of Publication: 2015 Bibliography/Reference: Jansen, Michael, Yasmeen Lari Social Media Links Contact Info (+92) 51-9252516 info@doam.gov.pk Sir Syed Memorial Building, 19th Atta-Turk Avenue, Sector G-5/1, Islamabad Quick Links - National Heritage & Culture Division, Government of Pakistan - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, KPK - Directorate of Archaeology Tourism Department, Punjab - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, Balochistan - Culture, Tourism, Antiquities and Archive Department, Sindh - Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology & Museums Department Gilgit-Baltistan - National Museum of Pakistan, Karachi - Islamabad Museum, Islamabad - UNESCO, Islamabad office, Islamabad - UNESCO World Heritage Centre Department of Archaeology and Museums © 2026.
